amendment_2026_11_17: 728-EF §5 item 2 contract amendment (G1): the five write names above were absent from this artifact; they are recorded as verified_disabled_* — present in the live catalogs but NOT enabled on the portal — so enabled_catalog/enabled_served (the validator's D8-1 source, == the construction-phase enabled set) are intentionally unchanged. amendment_2026_11_17_w1: W1 portal flip (C1, 2026-11-17; G2): save_issue, save_comment and save_document move from disabled into linear enabled_catalog/enabled_served above, together with their Cloudflare portal flip — the move the G1 amendment anticipated. Evidence: loop-architecture writer-activation-c1-notes.md — PUT 2026-11-17T21:54:36Z on portal writer (linear server only; new modified_at 2026-11-17T21:54:40.014Z), independently read back in a fresh session: writer/linear enabled is exactly the 7 {get_issue, list_issues, list_comments, list_issue_statuses, save_issue, save_comment, save_document}, disabled 71 (the construction 74 minus exactly the three flipped names). Of the three, only save_document sat in verified_disabled_* (recorded by G1); save_issue/save_comment were in the C1 baseline's disabled set without a verified_disabled_* entry here — all three are now enabled_*, and linear verified_disabled_* is empty. The four google-calendar write names stay verified_disabled_* (W3 not flipped). The gmail and google-calendar servers are unchanged in this artifact (C1: attachments unchanged, reads only) — the portal still serves their reads; Writer's Google reads move to personal-mcp at the include level (role-configs.json / contract-mapping.json, G2), so those served names no longer render into the writer-portal include.
